question: What do we call it when we move very fast on our feet? 🏃
explanation: Awesome! When we want to move very fast to reach somewhere quickly, we run on our feet! 🏃
hint: It is much faster than walking.

question: How do soldiers move together in a straight line? 💂
explanation: Great job! Soldiers march together by lifting their knees high and swinging their arms. 💂
hint: Left, right, left, right!

question: What is jumping on only one foot called? 🦩
explanation: Super! When you lift one foot and jump on the other, you are hopping! 🦩
hint: Think of a flamingo or a kangaroo.

question: How do we jump up in the air? 🐇
explanation: Fantastic! To jump properly, we bend our knees and push up with both feet together. 🐇
hint: Bunnies do this all the time.

question: What do we use when we do skipping? 🪢
explanation: Awesome! We swing a jumping rope over our heads and hop over it. 🪢
hint: It is a long string you jump over.

question: How should we walk so no one can hear us? 🤫
explanation: Great job! Walking on our tiptoes makes us very quiet, just like a little mouse! 🐭
hint: Ballet dancers walk like this.

question: What do we do to stay up straight and not fall over? ⚖️
explanation: Super! Balancing helps us stand tall on one foot or walk on a narrow line without falling. ⚖️
hint: You do this when standing on one leg.

question: Which animal takes big, heavy stomping steps? 🐘
explanation: Fantastic! Elephants are huge animals that take big, heavy, stomping steps when they walk. 🐘
hint: It has a long trunk.

question: How should we stand when we are walking? 🧍
explanation: Awesome! Walking tall and straight with our heads up is the best way to walk safely. 🧍
hint: Like a proud soldier.

question: Where should we look while walking forward? 👀
explanation: Great job! Looking straight ahead helps us see where we are going and avoid bumping into things. 👀
hint: Look in the direction you are moving.

question: What moves back and forth when we walk or march? 💪
explanation: Super! Swinging our arms helps us balance and move smoothly when we walk or march. 💪
hint: They hang from your shoulders.

question: What is taking very small steps called? 👶
explanation: Fantastic! Very small and careful steps are called baby steps. 👶
hint: Tiny toddlers walk like this.

question: What is taking very big, long steps called? 👹
explanation: Awesome! Stretching your legs out far to take big steps is called taking giant steps. 👹
hint: A huge monster walks like this.

question: Which animal walks sideways? 🦀
explanation: Great job! Crabs have a funny walk where they move side to side instead of forward! 🦀
hint: It has claws and lives by the sea.

question: How do we move backward safely? 🔙
explanation: Super! When walking backward, we must look behind us to make sure we do not trip. 👀
hint: Turn your head to check your path.

question: What do we bend when we land from a high jump? 🦵
explanation: Fantastic! Bending our knees when we land makes it soft and keeps our legs safe from getting hurt. 🦵
hint: It is the joint in the middle of your leg.

question: What do we do when the teacher says 'Freeze'? 🧊
explanation: Awesome! When we play the freeze game, we must stop moving and stand perfectly still like a statue. 🛑
hint: Stay very still like ice.

question: What is a fun way to walk like a penguin? 🐧
explanation: Great job! Walking with your toes pointing up and resting on your heels looks just like a waddling penguin! 🐧
hint: Keep your toes pointed up to the sky.

question: What shape do we walk on to test our balance? 📏
explanation: Super! Walking exactly on a straight line without stepping off is a great way to practice balancing. 📏
hint: It looks like a long ruler on the floor.

question: Which body part touches the ground first when marching? 🦶
explanation: Fantastic! When we step forward in a march or walk, our heel touches the ground first, then our toes. 🦶
hint: It is the back part of your foot.

question: How do we breathe when we are running very fast? 😮‍💨
explanation: Awesome! Running makes our body work hard, so we need to take fast and deep breaths for more energy. 😮‍💨
hint: Your chest moves in and out quickly.

question: What is galloping like? 🐎
explanation: Great job! Galloping is a fun step-and-leap movement, just like a horse running in a field! 🐎
hint: Giddy-up, horsey!

question: What should we do before we start running and playing? 🤸
explanation: Super! Doing little stretches to warm up our body gets our muscles ready to play safely. 🤸
hint: Get your body ready to move.

question: What do we call jumping over something like a log or puddle? 🦘
explanation: Fantastic! Leaping is when you take a big jump forward to cross over something in your way! 🦘
hint: A big forward jump.

question: What should we do if we feel very tired after running? 🪑
explanation: Awesome! It is very important to listen to our bodies, stop, and rest when we feel too tired. 🪑
hint: Take a break to catch your breath.

question: What animal jumps from lily pad to lily pad? 🐸
explanation: Great job! Frogs sit in a squat and use their strong legs to jump far across the water. 🐸
hint: Ribbit! Ribbit!

question: Which foot do we hop on? 🦵
explanation: Super! You can practice hopping on your left foot, and then switch to your right foot! 🦵
hint: You can pick which one to use.

question: What do we call a path that goes left and right like a snake? 🐍
explanation: Fantastic! A zig-zag line bends sharply to the left and then right, and walking on it is a fun game! 🐍
hint: It looks like the letter Z.

question: How do we hold our arms when we are trying to balance on a line? ✈️
explanation: Awesome! Holding your arms out to the side like airplane wings helps keep your body steady and balanced. ✈️
hint: Pretend you are an airplane.

question: What is it called when you step and hop on one foot, then step and hop on the other? 👧
explanation: Great job! Skipping without a rope is a happy step-hop, step-hop movement! 👧
hint: It is a bouncy way to walk.

question: What can you balance on top of your head while walking? 📚
explanation: Super! Walking with a book on your head makes you walk very smooth and tall so it does not fall. 📚
hint: Something you read.

question: When walking in a line with friends, what should you do? 🚶
explanation: Fantastic! Walking nicely in a line and following the leader keeps everyone safe and happy! 🚶
hint: Stay behind the person in front of you.

question: What makes a loud beat that helps soldiers march together? 🥁
explanation: Awesome! The steady boom-boom sound of a drum helps people keep a perfect marching rhythm. 🥁
hint: You hit it with drumsticks.

question: What happens if we run too fast indoors? 🏠
explanation: Great job! Running is for outside. If we run fast inside the house, we might bump into things and fall. 🤕
hint: You could get an ouchie.

question: How should we walk down the stairs? 🪜
explanation: Super! Taking one step at a time slowly and holding the railing keeps us safe on the stairs. 🪜
hint: Do not rush or run.

question: What kind of walk looks like an animal on its hands and feet? 🐻
explanation: Fantastic! A bear crawl is a fun exercise where you walk on your hands and feet with your knees off the ground! 🐻
hint: Like a big furry forest animal.

question: What is the very first step a baby learns to do? 👶
explanation: Awesome! Before we can run or jump, we all learn to take our first slow steps as babies. 🚶
hint: It is how babies start moving.

question: What helps our bones and muscles grow strong? 💪
explanation: Great job! Walking, running, and playing games outside make our muscles strong and keep us healthy! 💪
hint: Exercise does this.

question: What should we do with our arms to run faster? 🏃
explanation: Super! Bending your elbows and swinging your arms back and forth fast helps your legs run faster! 💪
hint: Move them back and forth.

question: What do we call a fun walk where we squat down low? 🦆
explanation: Fantastic! Squatting down low and waddling forward is called a duck walk! Quack quack! 🦆
hint: Quack quack!

question: What helps us calm down after running a lot? 🌬️
explanation: Awesome! Taking slow, deep breaths helps our heart slow down and makes us feel relaxed. 🌬️
hint: Breathe in, breathe out.

question: What drink is the best to have after we play and sweat? 💧
explanation: Great job! When we sweat, our body needs fresh water to stay cool and healthy. 💧
hint: It is clear and comes from a tap.

question: How can you walk together with your best friend? 🤝
explanation: Super! Holding hands with a partner and matching their steps is a nice way to walk together. 🤝
hint: You use your fingers and palms.

question: What part of the foot do you stand on when tiptoeing? 🩰
explanation: Fantastic! You lift your heels and stand only on your toes to walk very quietly and tall. 🩰
hint: The very front of your foot.

question: What do we do when we stretch our arms up to the sky? ☀️
explanation: Awesome! Stretching your arms way up high makes your back feel great and makes you super tall! ☀️
hint: Pretend you are touching the clouds.

question: What do we do to cool down our body after playing? 🧘
explanation: Great job! Walking slowly helps your heart beat normally again after you run really fast. 🧘
hint: Take it easy and slow.

question: How does walking in nature or a park make us feel? 🌳
explanation: Super! Walking outside in the fresh air with trees and birds makes our mind and body very happy! 🌳
hint: It brings a smile to your face.

question: What do we do when we move our feet to music? 💃
explanation: Fantastic! Moving your feet, stepping, and jumping to a fun beat is called dancing! 💃
hint: You do this at a party.

question: What is a fun race where you jump inside a potato sack? 🥔
explanation: Awesome! In a sack race, you put your legs inside a bag and hop all the way to the finish line! 🥔
hint: You use a big cloth bag.

question: What is the most important rule when playing running games? 😊
explanation: Great job! Moving, running, and playing games is all about staying healthy and having lots of fun with friends! 😊
hint: Keep smiling and laughing!
